Hela: of Mice & Magic - Coming Q4 2026 | PS5 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012485

Hela: of Mice & Magic, the wholesome 3D open-world adventure inspired by the breathtaking landscapes of Northern Sweden, is coming in Q4 2026.

More than 1 million players have already wishlisted Hela: of Mice & Magic across PC and consoles. Seeing so many of you excited to explore the magical forests, wetlands, and misty mires means the world to us. Mice thank you from the bottom of their tiny hearts — and so do we! Your support gives us the energy to push through the final stage of the development.
We can't wait to welcome you into the world of Hela later this year. 🐭✨

Wishlist Hela: of Mice & Magic on PlayStation®5 and join us on this wholesome adventure!
